seo.h1: Shady Maple Smorgasbord Prices and Hours

question: How Much Is Shady Maple Smorgasbord?
quick_answer: On weekdays, Shady Maple Smorgasbord costs $14.99 for breakfast, $20.99 for lunch and $27.99 to $30.99 for dinner, depending on the themed night. On Saturdays, breakfast is $17.99, the Early Bird is $29.99 and the Grand Menu is $32.99. A 12% service fee is added. Shady Maple is open Monday through Saturday from 7 a.m. (last seating 7:30 p.m.) and is closed on Sundays. Kids 3 and under eat free.
key_facts: Mon-Sat 7 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. last seating; closed Sundays

body.heading: Weekday prices
body.text: Shady Maple's posted price list puts weekday breakfast (7 to 10 a.m.) at $14.99 per adult and weekday lunch (10:45 a.m. to 3:15 p.m.) at $20.99. Dinner starts at 4 p.m. with a last seating at 7:30 p.m., and the price depends on the night: Monday Steak Night is $27.99, Tuesday Seafood Night $30.99, Wednesday Prime Rib Night $27.99, Thursday Rib & Wing Night $27.99, and Friday's Grand Menu $29.99.

body.heading: Saturday prices
body.text: Saturday breakfast is $17.99, and Shady Maple advertises savings for coming between 7 and 8 a.m. From 11 a.m. to 1 p.m., the Saturday Early Bird costs $29.99 and includes the dinner features. From 1 p.m. until the last seating at 7:30 p.m., the Saturday Grand Menu is $32.99. All prices are before the 12% service fee and Pennsylvania sales tax.

body.heading: Discounts for kids, seniors and military
body.text: Children 3 and under eat free, and kids 4 to 10 get 50% off. Seniors 60 to 89 get 10% off, and guests 90 and older get 50% off. Service members get 25% off on Wednesdays with military ID. Shady Maple also offers a free birthday meal program; if your birthday falls on a Sunday, reviewers say you can use it the next Monday.

body.heading: Hours and holiday closings
body.text: Shady Maple is open Monday through Saturday. Doors open at 7 a.m., the last seating is at 7:30 p.m., and food stays on the buffet until about 8:15 p.m. It's closed every Sunday, as well as on New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas. On Christmas Eve, the last seating is at noon. Prices can be higher on holidays.

body.heading: What to expect
body.text: Shady Maple, in East Earl, Pennsylvania, is often called the largest buffet in America, with roughly 200 feet of Pennsylvania Dutch food, from scrapple and fried chicken to carved prime rib and pies. Weekday mornings are the least crowded. Shady Maple also sells take-out meals. See our Shady Maple menu page for a full price table.

faqs.q: How much is Shady Maple for breakfast?
faqs.a: $14.99 on weekdays and $17.99 on Saturday, plus a 12% service fee.

faqs.q: How much is Shady Maple for dinner?
faqs.a: $27.99 to $30.99 on weeknights, depending on the theme, and $32.99 for the Saturday Grand Menu.

faqs.q: Is Shady Maple open on Sunday?
faqs.a: No. Shady Maple is closed every Sunday.

faqs.q: What time does Shady Maple close?
faqs.a: The last seating is at 7:30 p.m., and the buffet stays open until about 8:15 p.m.

faqs.q: Do kids eat free at Shady Maple?
faqs.a: Children 3 and under eat free; kids 4 to 10 get 50% off.
